sn51.29:1.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn51.29:1.2: katamā nu kho bhante iddhi katamo iddhipādo katamā iddhipādabhāvanā katamā iddhipādabhāvanāgāminī paṭipadāti.
sn51.29:2.1: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
sn51.29:3.2: yo bhikkhave maggo yā paṭipadā iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya saṃvattati.
sn51.29:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
